title: Marvel's X-Men Just Got a Whole Lot Bigger (and Weirder)!
summary:
Have you ever wondered who would play your favorite X-Men if they joined the Marvel movies? Well, wonder no more! At a huge Disney event called D23, Marvel boss Kevin Feige announced the cast for the new X-Men movie, coming out May 5, 2028. And guess what? Some of the choices are pretty surprising.

First, the big news: Adam Driver, who played Kylo Ren in Star Wars, will be the bad guy Mr. Sinister. That's a villain with a very creepy name. Also, Sadie Sink, who you might know from Stranger Things, is already playing Jean Grey. She first showed up as Jean in the Spider-Man movie this summer. Christopher Abbott will be Professor X, the leader of the X-Men. And a brand-new actress named Maya Boyd will play Storm, who can control the weather.

But here's the tricky part. For years, the X-Men movies were made by a different company, Fox. Now that Disney owns Marvel and Fox, they have to mix the old and new. Some actors from the old movies, like Patrick Stewart as Professor X, might still show up in other Marvel movies. But for this new X-Men team, they're starting fresh with new faces.

One big question remains: who will play Wolverine? Hugh Jackman played him for a long time, but he might be done. Or maybe not! We'll have to wait and see. Until then, get ready for a whole new team of mutants.
why_it_matters: Just like a favorite team can get new players, your favorite movie heroes can change actors, and this new X-Men team gives you something exciting to look forward to.

background_read: Marvel is the movie studio behind superheroes such as Spider-Man, Iron Man, and the Avengers.
For many years, 20th Century Fox (a different movie studio) owned the movie rights to the X-Men, so Marvel could not put those characters in its other superhero films.
Disney bought Fox, which is why Marvel boss Kevin Feige (the president of Marvel Studios) can now plan a new X-Men team.
